<div class="card-body">
'''Rectenna''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レクテナ（整流アンテナ）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォースを使用して任意の宇宙船に配備する。相手が同じ星系で戦闘を宣言した場合、“リアクション”としてその星系にカードを配備することができる（フォースは通常通りに支払う）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rectenna-SWCA-67713.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ファブリテック社製通信／センサー・ユニット。受動／能動型のスキャナー、高出力妨害システム、船間通信機および短距離索敵装置としての機能を持つ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rectenna.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on any starship. If the opponent declared a battle at the same system, you may deploy cards to that system as a react. Force is paid as usual.

'''Lore:'''
A Fabritech-made communications and sensor unit. It functions as a passive/active scanner, high-output jamming system, ship-to-ship communicator, and short-range search device.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore lists passive/active scanners and a short-range search device.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rectenna]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
